title: D02: Qualify BNGIR round trips across the supported semantic surface

source.contract: Verify lossless BNGIR round trips for all BNGL constructs across BNGL→v0.2→BNGL, v0.1→v0.2, and native reconstruction routes; preserve metadata, units, observables, actions, delays and dependencies across versions with exact certificates and independent downstream execution.

oracle.identity: Independent analytic continuous-time laws (delayed reaction differential equations, first-order decay, pure death CTMC), pinned BNG2, and semantic equality certificate engine.
oracle.law: Reconstructed models must match source facts and exact analytic execution trajectories (decay A(t)=A0*exp(-kt), delayed completion B(t)=A0*(1-exp(-k(t-tau))) for t>=tau, 0 for t<tau); all v0.1 fields are losslessly representable in v0.2; wire mutations produce detectable semantic differences or fail closed.
